biotools.summary: CuticleTrace is a toolkit for capturing cell outlines from leaf cuticles, streamlining and automating segmentation and measurement for paleoecological and paleoclimatological studies. It uses Fiji and R-based functions and offers improved measurement accuracy compared to existing methods.
